reasoning: The question asks whether the Federal Reserve's primary credit discount rate will increase between March 15 and March 22, 2026 (a 7-day window). The primary credit rate is set by the Fed relative to the FOMC's target range for the federal funds rate. Rate changes typically occur at scheduled FOMC meetings, which happen roughly every 6 weeks. The probability of an unscheduled rate change within a single week is very low. Without knowledge of scheduled FOMC meetings in March 2026, I assume no meeting is scheduled during this narrow window, making an increase highly unlikely.
